HUSKY: Humanoid Skateboarding System via Physics-Aware Whole-Body Control Robotics: Science and Systems (RSS) 2026 Jinrui Han * 1,2 , Dewei Wang * 1,3 , Chenyun Zhang 1 , Xinzhe Liu 1,4 , Ping Luo 2 , Chenjia Bai †1 , Xuelong Li †1 * Equal Contribution † Corresponding Author 1 Institute of Artificial Intelligence (TeleAI), China Telecom 2 The University of Hong Kong 3 University of Science and Technology of China 4 ShanghaiTech University [ ](https://mujocolab.github.io/mjlab/main/index.html) [ ](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03205) [ ](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.03205.pdf) [ ](https://husky-humanoid.github.io/) [ ](https://x.com/jinrui82) ## Overview [ ]() This repository contains the official implementation of our paper: [HUSKY: Humanoid Skateboarding System via Physics-Aware Whole-Body Control](https://husky-humanoid.github.io/). In this work, we propose a learning-based whole-body control framework that empowers humanoid robots to perform dynamic skateboarding. This repository contains: - The mjlab training framework ([`src/mjlab_husky`](src/mjlab_husky)) - Customized RL implementations ([`rsl_rl/`](rsl_rl/)) - Motion data for AMP and trajectory planning ([`dataset/`](dataset/)) - Lightweight MuJoCo evaluation scripts ([`test_scene/`](test_scene/)) - Tested checkpoints ([`ckpts/`](ckpts/)) ## Install This code has been tested on Ubuntu 22.04 with CUDA 13.0. To install this repository, please follow these steps: 1. **Install the [`uv`](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/#installation-methods) package manager** (if you don't have it yet): 2. **Clone the repository**: 3. **Sync dependencies**: ## Training Example ## Play Examples We also provide a lite MuJoCo simulation script for evaluation: The [`test_scene/mjlab_scene.xml`](test_scene/mjlab_scene.xml) file is automatically generated from the mjlab [`scene_cfg`](src/mjlab_husky/asset_zoo/robots/skateboard/g1_skater_constants.py). >[!abstract] 一句话总结：提出 HUSKY——一个基于学习的物理感知全身控制框架，用强化学习（rsl_rl 定制实现）配合 AMP 动作先验与轨迹规划，在自研 mjlab（MuJoCo 系）训练框架中训练，使 Unitree G1 人形机器人完成滑板这一动态全身任务，并开源训练框架、运动数据、MuJoCo 评测脚本与已测 checkpoint。


# 一、动机

> 人形机器人做滑板这类「板-人」欠驱动、富接触、被动轮式滑动的高动态全身任务时，现有全身控制方法难以同时兼顾平衡、接触力与物理约束，缺少系统性的学习式解决方案。


# 二、方法

> 提出 HUSKY——一个基于学习的物理感知全身控制框架，用强化学习（rsl_rl 定制实现）配合 AMP 动作先验与轨迹规划，在自研 mjlab（MuJoCo 系）训练框架中训练，使 Unitree G1 人形机器人完成滑板这一动态全身任务，并开源训练框架、运动数据、MuJoCo 评测脚本与已测 checkpoint。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 论文为 RSS 2026 投稿（arXiv:2602.03205），开源了完整训练与评测代码：mjlab 训练框架、定制 RL 实现、用于 AMP 与轨迹规划的运动数据集、轻量 MuJoCo 评测脚本（test_scene/mjlab_scene.xml 由 g1_skater_constants.py 自动生成）以及可用 checkpoint，并在 Ubuntu 22.04 + CUDA 13.0 上验证通过；摘要/README 中未给出量化成功率、速度或能耗等具体数字。


# 四、对我的启发

> 局限：目前仅从仓库说明无法判断泛化性、真实硬件实验规模与定量性能。启发：把「物理感知」显式引入全身控制，对欠驱动 + 富接触的被动动力学对象（滑板、推车、轮椅等）是可复用的范式，且完整的开源训练栈（mjlab + rsl_rl + AMP 数据 + 评测场景）为人形全身高动态技能的可复现研究提供了直接基线。
